Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions).

Pair list for `tests/unit/metrics/`, `tests/unit/workflow/` and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/`, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment. Format: `base | heldout LOC | RENAME (differing defs)`; the twin is `<base>_heldout.py`. No test-function name collides in these pairs; definitions that collide with DIFFERENT bodies are named in the RENAME column (rename on merge); every other colliding definition is identical (dedupe: keep the base copy; `pytestmark` counts here). Paths under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` are stated at the current name (origin/main 083620b0); the reconciler epic's rename carries them.

`tests/unit/metrics/` — 13 pairs, 4 renames:

`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` — 6 pairs, 3 renames:

| # | base | heldout LOC | RENAME (differing defs) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 17 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_canonical_link_diff.py` | 128 | fixture `ol` |
| 18 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_canonical_outbound_equivalence.py` | 148 | `_StubBindingStore`, `_emit`, `_jira`, `_ticket`, fixtures `backend`, `od` |
| 19 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface.py` | 99 | `_backend` (the autouse fixture `_clean` has IDENTICAL bodies — keep the base copy) |
| 20 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_get_rotation.py` | 323 | - |
| 21 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_richtext_port.py` | 87 | - (the held-out twin cites bug 1bb2-5da5 in its docstring; carry that paragraph into the merged docstring) |
| 22 | `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_transport.py` | 305 | - |

22 pairs; 8 renames = rows 3, 5, 9, 11, 16, 17, 18, 19.

Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_load_heldout`, `ol_heldout` for a fixture, `_StubBindingStore_heldout` for a class) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions.

Merge recipe per pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph; dedupe identical definitions (incl. `pytestmark`); rename differing definitions with the `_heldout` suffix and repoint callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Record per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before, `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after.

Mechanism note (enumeration (7)): `autouse_fixture` keys are `autouse_fixture::<path>::<name>`; the merge of row 19 keeps `autouse_fixture::tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface.py::_clean` and drops the `..._heldout.py::_clean` key, which buckets `stale`. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0 with `stale>0` (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:51-57`); `--update-stale` is maintenance-only and must not be run.
